text:
Marta: Heads-up — spotted 8 GPUs flagged with intermittent ECC + Xid surges on t1-west-3. Autoscaler drained 4 nodes, scheduler is bumping backlog. Moving the remaining at-risk GPUs into quarantine pool. Need routing plan for spare cascade staging and courier retag. ETA on spare kitting?

Sam: Can you paste serials and node IDs? I'll open vendor tickets. Also what's priority here? :exclamation:

Marta: 
```
serial,NODE,fail_code
NV-934792,tn12-gpu-03,XID-71
NV-934793,tn12-gpu-07,ECC-uncorr
NV-934794,tn14-gpu-02,XID-71
NV-934795,tn14-gpu-05,intermittent
NV-934796,tn14-gpu-08,ECC-uncorr
NV-934797,tn15-gpu-01,XID-45
NV-934798,tn15-gpu-04,intermittent
NV-934799,tn15-gpu-09,XID-71
```

Viv: Logistics — crossdock slot available but customs window in region closes Wed. Handcarry only for P1. These are P2 but affecting burst clusters. Recommend retag now and hold in staging for 48h. :clipboard:

Raj: From infra — do we replace GPUs or whole nodes? If GPU-only replace we need 1 sysadmin each shift to schedule attach.

Lena: SRE — metrics show Xid spikes rose after kernel 5.15 rollout in t1-west-3. Would prefer to open a canary revert test, but replacement frees capacity faster. SLA note: if a customer-facing lane impacted escalate.

Marta: These are non-customer jobs but capacity pressure causing queue delays. Prefer to proceed with replacements to restore capacity.

Sam: Opening vendor RMAs and will attach logs. Will post ticket IDs. Also need retag labels + manifest path for courier.

ops-bot: ticket-created: VND-21001 for NV-934792. ETA vendor RMA 48-72h.

Viv: Staging prep — printing retag CSV at s3://redwood-ops/spare-manifests/2109876543-retag.csv. I booked staging slot Thu 09:00-12:00 local, courier pick window Fri 14:00-17:00.

Diego: Cost check — cross-region courier from eu-central is ~$350/unit, local depot swap ~$45. For P2 prefer local depot swap if available.

Sam: Agreed. If vendor RMA delayed >72h we'll authorize on-call handcarry; finance to pre-approve a one-off.

Raj: Replacement checklist:
1) create node-swap ticket
2) drain node `./infra/drain-node --node <node>`
3) attach spare
4) run healthcheck: 
```
./scripts/gpu-healthcheck.sh --node <node> --serial <serial>
# expect: PASS: mem, temp, ECC=0, Xid<3
```

Sam: Vendor tickets opened: VND-21001 VND-21002 VND-21003. Added logs and retry traces. Will update ETA.

Marta: Thanks. Viv will coordinate staging/retag. Raj/Lena schedule replacements 02:00-06:00 UTC to minimize job impact.

Viv: Acknowledged. Labels printed, 8 spares reserved in staging. Courier retagging will include new tamper tape and depot barcode.

ops-bot: inventory-update: reserved_spares:-8

Diego: I'll run a canary kernel revert on tn14-gpu-02 to validate Xid trend; if improved we can rollback rollout.

Raj: Noted — escalate to oncall if any RMA >72h. I'll follow up on node-scheduling tomorrow. :thumbsup:
